answer: Contribution-merged identity: a new identity must earn a jade badge by landing one contribution in an established public project, approved by two independent maintainers who stake reputation on the merge. The work enters the Ridge, a rotating panel that checks originality, tests, and usefulness, rejecting filler pull requests outright. Meanwhile the applicant holds one Lotus probationary slot, burned on rejection, so failure cannot be retried for free. Forging 1,000 puppets means 1,000 separately accepted contributions, each reviewed alone with no bulk discount, while an honest user pays once.
